title: fanoutqa: What are the capital cities of the countries that hosted the 5 most recent Olympics? (d2049103e53dbeb5)

chat_history.content: What are the capital cities of the countries that hosted the 5 most recent Olympics?

content.content:
We need to answer: capital cities of the countries that hosted the 5 most recent Olympics. The most recent Olympics: 2024 Summer in Paris, 2022 Winter in Beijing, 2021 Summer in Tokyo (actually 2020 but held in 2021), 2018 Winter in PyeongChang, 2016 Summer in Rio de Janeiro. Wait order: 2024 (Paris), 2022 (Beijing), 2021 (Tokyo), 2018 (PyeongChang), 2016 (Rio). That's 5. But note that the 2022 Winter Olympics were in Beijing, China. The capital of China is Beijing (same). The 2024 Summer Olympics will be in Paris, France, capital Paris. 2021 Tokyo, Japan capital Tokyo. 2018 PyeongChang, South Korea capital Seoul. 2016 Rio, Brazil capital Brasília.

Thus answer: Paris, France; Beijing, China; Tokyo, Japan; Seoul, South Korea; Brasília, Brazil. Provide list. Also mention years. Probably ask for capital cities of the countries that hosted. So list capitals. Provide a short answer. No Wikipedia needed. But we could verify with Wikipedia. Use search tool for each. Probably not necessary. I can answer directly.

content:
**Capital cities of the countries that hosted the five most recent Olympic Games**

| Olympic Games (year) | Host city | Host country | Capital city of host country |
|----------------------|-----------|--------------|------------------------------|
| 2024 Summer Olympics | Paris | France | **Paris** |
| 2022 Winter Olympics | Beijing | China | **Beijing** |
| 2021 Summer Olympics (held in 2021 but officially the 2020 Games) | Tokyo | Japan | **Tokyo** |
| 2018 Winter Olympics | PyeongChang | South Korea | **Seoul** |
| 2016 Summer Olympics | Rio de Janeiro | Brazil | **Brasília** |

So the capital cities are **Paris, Beijing, Tokyo, Seoul, and Brasília**.
